crossRefs.note: Yahweh, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.
I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!
Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth.
Revive me, Yahweh, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

translations.web: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, Yahweh, according to your word.
translations.bsb: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
translations.kjv: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O LORD, according unto thy word.
translations.asv: I am afflicted very much: Quicken me, O Jehovah, according unto thy word.
